steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: nth term: A formula that allows you to find any term in a sequence without working out all the previous terms. | Position numbers: The position of each term (1st = position 1, 2nd = position 2, etc.)

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Find the nth term of: 6, 10, 14, 18, 22, ... | Find the nth term of: 50, 46, 42, 38, 34, ... | Find the 100th term of: 7n - 3

steps.title: Lesson 4: Exam Practice
steps.body: Extended Answer 6 marks: A pattern uses tiles: 7, 11, 17, 25, 35, ... (a) Show this is a quadratic sequence. (b) Find the nth term. (c) How many tiles are needed for the 20th pattern? (d) Is 200 tiles possible? <div class="
